name: usage-guard
description: Stops Claude when the 5-hour or weekly usage limit reaches a threshold, warns every open session, and resumes stopped work when the 5-hour window resets

threshold.title: Stop at (%)
threshold.description: Stop Claude when the 5-hour or weekly usage reaches this percentage.

autoResume.title: Resume after the 5-hour reset
autoResume.description: When the 5-hour limit stopped Claude, resume the task automatically once that window resets.

resumeWeeklyBelow.title: Resume only if weekly is below (%)
resumeWeeklyBelow.description: After the 5-hour reset, resume stopped work only when weekly usage is below this percentage.

notifyAllSessions.title: Warn every open session
notifyAllSessions.description: When the threshold is reached, show the warning in every open Claude Code session, not only the one that was working.
